plan.notes: Source: official Berkshire Community College 2026-2027 Catalog (berkshirecc.smartcatalogiq.com 'current' catalog; catalog root breadcrumb confirms '2026-2027 Catalog'), program page 'Computer Science (A.S.)': https://berkshirecc.smartcatalogiq.com/current/catalog/programs-of-study/computer-information-systems/computer-science-a-s/. TRUE credential per the catalog: 'Associate in Science, Computer Information Systems. Concentration/Option/Track: Computer Science' (page title 'Computer Science (A.S.)'). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30 from the page's 'Suggested Pathway to Graduation' (semester-by-semester sample sequence; the catalog calls it 'a suggestion for completing this program in two years'). Credit math: pathway term totals 18/18/15/14 = 65, matching the program's own requirement split (Program Courses 46 + General Education Courses 19 = 65). Caveats: (1) ENT-161 (Physics I: Mechanics, 4 cr) is printed after the Second Semester total row and ENT-162 (Engineering Physics II: Fluids, Heat And Sound, 4 cr) after the Third Semester total row, each marked 'See footnote 2'; both are counted inside those semesters' published totals (18 and 15), consistent with the 2023-2024 and 2018-2019 catalogs where they appeared inline in the semester tables. (2) Footnote 2 in the 2026-2027 catalog reads 'Two semesters of another laboratory science sequence may be substituted for ENT-161 and ENT-261'; ENT-261 (Physics II: Electricity, Magnetism & Light) was the third-semester physics in the 2023-2024 pathway, while the 2026-2027 pathway places ENT-162 in the third semester - the footnote appears to carry over the older course number; transcribed the pathway as printed. (3) Prereqs verified from current-catalog course description pages: CIS-125 requires 'CIS-124 with grade of C+ or higher or permission of instructor; MAT-102 or permission of the instructor' (modeled as CIS-124; MAT-102 listed in external_prereqs); CIS-211 requires 'CIS-125 with grade of C+ or higher, or permission of the instructor' (modeled as CIS-125); MAT-152 requires 'MAT-151 or permission of the instructor' (modeled as MAT-151). The 'or permission of instructor' alternatives are documented here, not modeled. No other course prereqs were transcribed: the catalog course pages for CIS-231, CIS-232, ENT-233, ENT-161, ENT-162, MAT-123, MAT-151, and CIS-102 were not verified on the 2026-2027 catalog, so their prereq fields are empty rather than invented. (4) CIS-124's catalog prereq is placement skills ('Skills: ENG-020; Skills: MAT-029 or permission of instructor', seen on the 2021-2022 course page) - placement/assessment detail, documented here, not modeled as a course prereq. (5) Choice slots: two 3-credit English Composition/Writing slots, one 3-credit Behavioral and Social Science slot, one 3-credit Humanities and Fine Arts slot, one 3-credit Communication slot, and one 3-credit Professional Elective (catalog footnote 1: 'chosen from courses designated CIS or ENT'). (6) Program note: 'A minimum of three CIS courses must be taken in the five years prior to graduation.' Minimum cumulative average 2.000 overall and in all CIS & ENT courses.
